messages:
kevin: Heads up — we're onboarding two external analysts next week. Need to finalize what log tiers they can access, how long we retain full payloads, and the request/unlock flow. Proposal below.

mia: +1. Must be least-privilege by default. My checklist: masked PII, no direct CMK decrypt for analyst principals, timeboxed snapshots, audit trail for every unwrap, and a request template. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thinking tiering: 
- Tier A: Scoped live views (searchable metadata only, tokenized IDs)
- Tier B: Timeboxed forensics snapshots (CMK-proxy unwrap, short TTL)
- Tier C: Auditor aggregates/rollups (no raw PII)
This keeps production queries cheap and low-risk.

ana: We should codify the CMK rules: analysts never get `kms:Decrypt` on the CMK. Use a key-proxy service with `kms:Decrypt` and `sts:AssumeRole` for the proxy, and require a ticket for any unwrap. Proxy logs go to `audit.kms.unwraps` index.

ana: Example request template (paste into ticket):
```
requester: <name + team>
justification: <why raw payload needed>
time-window: <start ISO> to <end ISO> (max 24h)
fields_needed: <list of fields>
expiry: <TTL, e.g. 4h>
approver: <oncall/sec-owner>
```

kevin: Nice. For retention I propose: full raw logs 90d, parsed metadata/indices 365d, and scrubbed long-term archives 3 years (PII replaced with tokens). We also need a short TTL for any CMK-unwrapped snapshot: default 4h and auto-delete.

mia: That matches compliance asks we saw. Also add mandatory training and an NDA for external analysts before issuing any unwrap ticket.

sam: Quick RBAC snippet for the forensics role (draft):
```
Policy: "analyst.forensics"
Allow: logs:read:metadata
Allow: logs:read:scrubbed
Deny: kms:Decrypt
Allow: proxy:RequestUnwrap with conditions: ticket_present == true, ticket_ttl <= 6h
```

security-bot: Automated note: unwrap requests without a ticket will be rejected by key-proxy v1.4. All unwrap actions will generate a high-fidelity audit event and email sec-ops.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: key-proxy/v1.4 -> adds ticket check, audit-hook, and TTL enforcement. Planned rollout to prod region us-west-2 in 48h. :rocket:

isabel: For onboarding checklist for the two analysts:
- sign NDA + access request form
- complete security training module (forensics basics)
- create ticket in #forensics-requests using template above
- run a supervised test unwrap against a synthetic dataset
- 1-week probation with read-only metadata access

kevin: Who owns the approval path? I can be secondary approver but need a primary owner from secops. @mia can you take primary approval for these two until we automate?

mia: I can take primary for the initial onboarding. I'll also nominate an approver rotation in the runbook.

sam: One more operational note: exports to external partners must be tokenized and scanned by DLP. No raw SIEM export leaves without redaction. Link to DLP playbook: https://redwood.internal/security/dlp-playbook

kevin: Thanks all — I'll update the onboarding doc and turn this into a short runbook. If nobody objects I'll create the ticket templates and update key-proxy RBAC rules today. :thumbsup:
